Good answer, although I think you’ve got cause and effect the wrong 
way round in main body paragraph 2.  I don’t think reliance on PS makes 
people prioritise beauty.  On the contrary - the rising popularity of PS is 
an indication of the superficial nature of modern society, in which 
appearance is prioritised over all other factors, like good behaviour and 
character.   
However, it’s good enough for a band score 9 for TR. 
You have a clear position throughout and all parts of the question are 
addressed.    
Your position is coherent and well-argued. The ideas are relevant, 
extended, and coherent. 
 
 
 
ADVICE ON BRAINSTORMING FOR TASK 2 
As you’re planning and writing your answer, remember to constantly 
ask yourself if you’re answering the question.  Check back to the 
question a few times as you think of ideas to make sure they're 
directly relevant.   
• Make sure your introduction directly addresses the question.
